entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I'm calling because I need to return some cycling shoes I bought. I'm just so disappointed. I've been a loyal customer for a long time.
I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that return for you. To get started, could I please have your order number?
Yes, it's VF8675309. I just... I saved up for these, and they're causing horrible blisters. I can't even get the cleats adjusted right because my feet hurt so much. I really needed this to work out.

I can certainly understand that frustration. Getting blisters is the last thing you want from a new pair of shoes. Let me pull up your order details... Okay, I see the purchase here. It looks like it was delivered 37 days ago.
Let me just review the return policy for this item. One moment.
Please, I really hope you can help. I was counting on that money for some holiday gifts.

Of course. And thank you for your patience. Okay, I've confirmed it. These shoes fall under our standard 90-day return policy, so you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Are you sure? Thank you so much.

Absolutely. And I also see you're one of our VIP members. We really appreciate your business over the years. As a thank you, I've processed the return with a complimentary prepaid shipping label, so you won't have to pay to send them back.
Wow, Charlie, that's wonderful. You've really turned my day around. I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

It's my pleasure to help. The email with the return label and instructions is on its way to your inbox now. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that's all. You've been a fantastic help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
